description: A solid neon shape (circle by default) expands from frame center, momentarily filling the frame, then collapses into a target anchor point on the incoming scene (e.g. the dot of an exclamation mark). Built on TransitionBoilerplate's motion model added to a CenterFiller overlay.

shapeColorToken.description: the wipe shape's fill color token

peakScale.description: max fill size, as a multiple of frame width

targetScale.description: final contracted scale the shape collapses to on the incoming side
